items.source:
Indexes the entities into the given index. The entities are collected into batches of {bulkSize} with a maximal timeout of 200 ms, see
invalid @link 
{@link reactor.core.publisher.Flux#bufferTimeout(int, java.time * .Duration)
} and then sent in a bulk operation to Elasticsearch.
items.translation:
将实体索引到指定的索引中。这些实体被收集为大小为 {bulkSize} 的批次，最大超时时间为 200 ms，请参阅
无效的 @link 
{@link reactor.core.publisher.Flux#bufferTimeout(int, java.time * .Duration)
}，随后以批量操作的方式发送至 Elasticsearch。

items.source: Indexes the entities into the index extracted from entity metadata. The entities are collected into batches of {bulkSize} with a maximal timeout of 200 ms, see Flux.bufferTimeout(int, java.time.Duration) and then sent in a bulk operation to Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 将实体索引到从实体元数据中提取的索引中。这些实体被收集为大小为 {bulkSize} 的批次，最大超时时间为 200 ms，请参阅 Flux.bufferTimeout(int, java.time.Duration)，然后将这些批次以批量操作的形式发送到 Elasticsearch。

items.source: Index entities in the given index. If the index is null or empty the index name provided via entity metadata is used. On errors returns with BulkFailureException with information about the failed operation

items.source:
Copies documents from a source to a destination. The source can be any existing index, alias, or data stream. The
destination must differ from the source. For example, you cannot reindex a data stream into itself. (@see
https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/docs-reindex.html)
items.translation: 从源索引、别名或数据流复制文档到目标位置。源可以是任何现有的索引、别名或数据流，而目标必须与源不同。例如，您无法将数据流重新索引到其自身。（@see https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/docs-reindex.html）
